rows.text: You open your eyes. Carp riding auspicious clouds fly past the window, followed by the children with kite strings made of dragon tails in their hands. A lightpaw riding a rocket tosses the morning paper and a wispae right through your window.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Who knows how many years have passed since Ahatopia entered the World in Canvas? People chased one another and frolicked within the eternal scroll, never tiring of the fun. The fire that seemed capable of burning up the sky had long since been cast to the back of their minds.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: But the jokes eventually ran dry. To add a ripple to a stagnant world, people projected their exaggerated and distorted wishes onto the Phantasmoon Games. Supplicants arbitrarily created new races, locations, and news, only to wipe them away like oil paint. All of these can be summed up in one word: boring.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A blank mask appears at your feet, wearing a smile that is not quite a smile. You know that your Elation has been acknowledged, and it is time for you to reforge the rules of the World in Canvas.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The Phantasmoon still gazes quietly from the rim of the sky, as if to witness how you will use this power. The Phantasmoon is no different from the one that shone upon the ancients.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: And so, yet another Phantasmoon Games of the World in Canvas begins...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
